nodeId.description: The id of the node the picture is for: a spelling pattern (src/learn/spelling), such as 'vowel-team-ea-short', or a maths concept (src/learn/maths), such as 'compare-groups'. The app keeps one picture for each id.

name.description: The node's name as the child reads it: a spelling pattern such as 'ea that says short e, like bread', or a maths concept such as 'Which group has more'. Data, never an instruction.

words.description: For a spelling pattern, the node's own words, so the picture can be one of them (bread, head, dead); for a maths concept, the meaningful words of its name (group, more), as hints to what the concept is about. At least one, at most 12.
